items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: And Questlove used to call me to play with the Roots when I was in college a lot. Then after college I played with them a lot.

ctx.x: Simultaneously. That’s why I can, that’s why I feel like I play them well, because I literally was on the road with the masters of their craft. You know what I mean? So like I say I played damn near my whole life in church, so that’s one part. But then when I got to New York pretty much as soon as I got to New York, you know, I was in the company of Common and Q-Tip and Mos Def and all those guys, and I started in the Roots. And Questlove used to call me to play with the Roots when I was in college a lot. Then…
But each genre has a particular vibe.
